exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing)
to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: записа́ть — to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing); за́пись — record, recording (e.g. sound); описа́ть — to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words); на́дпись — inscription, writing, label.

**Опиши** — описа́ть (perfective): to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words); to make / take an inventory (of), to inventory; (maths) to describe, to circumscribe. Wiktionary: о- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **описал** — описа́ть (perfective): to describe, to depict, to portray (to represent in words); to make / take an inventory (of), to inventory; (maths) to describe, to circumscribe. Wiktionary: о- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
